$comment: Which build this vault drives (CONVENTIONS §10). Every skill, the main-branch hook and /sync's board review read these values from here and nowhere else. _meta/check-vault.mjs check 15 fails while any ⟨…⟩ remains. Keys starting with $ are notes, not settings.
codeRepo: ⟨owner/name of the code repository on GitHub⟩
board: ⟨title of the GitHub Project that tracks the build⟩
$deployedToProduction: false until the product is first deployed to production. While false, CONVENTIONS §10 rule 5's suspension holds: an agent working an item marked Agent opens conflicts, deferrals and codebase problems itself. A person sets it to true on the day of that deployment.
$handoffDir: Where a milestone manager writes its handoff after ten issues (CONVENTIONS §10.1). Outside both repositories; ~ is the user's home folder.

gate.$affected: One command, run in the code repository, that runs the build and its guards, the lint, the timing ceilings and every test a change can reach. The parent branch is passed as its last argument (CONVENTIONS §10.3 standard 5).
gate.$phase: Every command of the whole gate, in the order they run (CONVENTIONS §10.3 standard 5). The vault guard is added by /verify itself.
phase: ⟨each command of the whole gate, in order⟩
